question:
Select the most appropriate one - word substitution of the given group of words.

A state of intense happiness and self - confidence.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. **"Euphoria"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Euphoria**: A feeling or state of intense excitement and happiness. (उत्साह: गहन उत्साह और खुशी की एक भावना या स्थिति।)

 
 
• **Example**: Winning the lottery filled her with an indescribable sense of euphoria.
 
 

 
• Euphoria expresses accurately the given group of words "A state of intense happiness and self - confidence".

Therefore, the correct answer is "Euphoria".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Intoxication**: The condition of being under the influence of alcohol or drugs. (नशा: अल्कोहल या दवाओं के प्रभाव में होने की स्थिति।)

 
 
• **Example**: His slurred speech and unsteady walk were clear signs of intoxication.
 
 
 
• **Touche**: Used to acknowledge a clever response in an argument or discussion. (टचे: एक तर्क या चर्चा में एक चतुर प्रतिक्रिया को स्वीकार करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।)
 
 
• **Example**: "Touché," he admitted, when his friend pointed out the contradiction in his argument.
 
 
 
• **Oblivion**: The state of being unaware or unconscious of what is happening. (भुलावा: यह हो रहा है कि क्या अनजान या बेहोश होने की स्थिति।)
 
 
• **Example**: After working for 48 hours straight, he collapsed into oblivion on his bed.
